data.gender_notes: Sonu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sonu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sonit' which means 'gold'. This name is radiant and full of warmth, symbolizing the golden sun that shines down upon us. In Hinduism, Sonu is also considered a name of the Hindu god Krishna, who is known for his love, kindness and loyalty. The name Sonu carries the meaning “Gold, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sonu usually hope their child will grow to embody gold, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sonu is a symbol of the divine energy of the sun, which is a source of life, love and light. It represents the golden essence of the soul, which is pure, radiant and full of wisdom.
data.etymology: Sonu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gold, Radiant.”
